angle: It teaches mean and proportion intervals side by side on one heart-rate dataset with spreadsheet recipes, then shows how to read published forest, error-bar, and funnel plots plus a frequentist-versus-Bayesian interpretation coda.
angle_detail: Start with the intuition at [01:01] to [03:51], then work the mean interval at [06:56] to [09:05] and the proportion interval at [12:03] to [13:41] back to back to see the t-versus-z contrast. Finish with the plot-reading stretch at [13:41] and the sealed section at [18:47] to [22:26] on why textbooks pair frequentist intervals with Bayesian wording. Watch the notation: pi is the population proportion against sample p, and theta marks a general parameter at [06:11].
